evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Agent behavior depends on the harness surrounding a language model, but it remains unclear whether language models can reliably improve such harnesses for hardware-design tasks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across the tested lineage, useful search, evidence, and finalization behaviors appeared in different candidates but did not consistently consolidate into a single harness that dominated across tasks and metrics.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: An auxiliary candidate improved on a four-task validation set excluded from search but tied its baseline on a subsequent 12-task replay containing both search and validation tasks, so the selected gain did not persist across the full pool.
